objTypeRef.description: For {@link App#rebuild} operations, used to pass the type associated with a request in a particular batch.

ids.description:
Specific list of ids to process/refresh.  If specified, then {@link startFromId} and {@link endId} are ignored.
If not specified (or empty) then all will be refreshed, applying any specified {@link startFromId} and
{@link endId}.

startFromId.description: Starting id for a range of ids to process.  Ignored if {@link ids} is also specified and not empty.

endId.description: Ending id for a range of ids to process.  Ignored if {@link startFromId} is not specified and not empty.

filter.description:
Filter to identify which objs to process.  Can be specified in addition to {@link ids} or
{@link startFromId}/{@link endId}.  In that case only objs that satisfy both the filter and the id base filter
will be promised.

batchSize.description: Number of ids to include in range id search for each invalidation request for for async call.

subBatchSize.description:
Number of objs to operate on in synchronous call.  When specified in async call, the value is passed in to
subsequent synchronous call. Defaults to {@link batchSize}.

invalidationsBatchSize.description: Number of entries to submit to the invalidation queue at one time for async call.

sync.description: True if the request should be processed synchronously.

priority.description: Initial priority of batch jobs started from async processing.

batchJob.description: If the request is part of a larger batch job (e.g. {@link App#rebuild}), this will be set by the framework to the owning batch job for orchestration.

batchNum.description: Numerical batch number set by the framework in {@link BatchJob.scheduleObjBatch}

title:
Batch of objects specified as a list of ids or a startFromId and endId.  Used in specs for various refresh operations (e.g. {@link RefreshCalcFieldsSpec}) and
during {@link App#rebuild} operations.
name: ObjBatch
